=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1755,1777 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `if not embedded` gate at line 1777 prevents `found.add()` whenever the `embedded` check at line 1755 is True. The `embedded` expression triggers when the lead contains `"://"`, which fires for the URL's own scheme. For `text = "https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/78"`, `host_prefix.search` finds `github.com/` at position 10, `lead_start` walks back to 0, `lead = "https://"`, `embedded = True`, `url_start` is reset to 0, and the `if not embedded` gate then drops the issue. The test `test_bare_urls_paths_and_closing_keywords_still_link` (line 286) asserts `_extract(f"https://github.com/{REPOSITORY}/issues/78") == [78]`, which under this trace would return `[]`. The same defect also breaks the `[1, 2]` assertion in `test_adjacent_issue_links_each_count_on_their_own` (line 139) and the `[1]` assertion for the `?x=fix #2` case in `test_closing_keyword_after_a_link_or_keyword_still_links` (line 144).
  WHY: The helper prints no issue numbers for any URL whose lead contains the URL's own scheme, so `LINKED_ISSUE_NUMBERS` and `LINEAGE_FINALIZE_ISSUE_NUMBERS` are empty for the simplest PR bodies. `issue_pr_status.yml` then logs "No linked issues found" instead of finding the issue, and a `claude/implement-plan-*` PR with a bare `https://github.com/<repo>/issues/<N>` body (no closing keyword) would skip the linked-issue handling entirely.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
